d:
Why is Prime Minister Narendra Modi asking corporate India to invest more and create jobs after 12 years in power? And why has the Opposition called his remarks an admission of India's jobless growth?
In this episode of Express Newsroom, Neeta Sharma is joined by Sandeep Singh, Ishaan, Manoj and Liz Mathew to decode the Prime Minister's remarks, the slowdown in private investment, concerns over employment and the political implications ahead of crucial Assembly elections.
